response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_replacement_cost, r.avg_per_day_rate, r.avg_per_day_rate - c.avg_per_day_rate AS amount_above_cross_rating_average FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN cross_rating AS c WHERE r.avg_per_day_rate > c.avg_per_day_rate ORDER BY r.rating;
